name: Orb · SHDR-08
description: Mother-of-pearl wrapped around the ball: a ten-octave feedback warp whose octaves each boil at their own multiple of the clock, banded by the cotangent of the warped coordinate so crests saturate flat and valleys floor to black, with the layers sampled through a stereographic projection of the dome so they compress toward the limb. Every band carries its own hue from a cosine palette keyed to the band coordinate, rotated further by the viewing angle the way thin-film interference actually behaves, and the golfed listing's uneven per-channel phase breaks each band edge into a warm shoulder and a deep blue one (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-08 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
